route.why: A soft-landing night close to the airport before the retreat programme begins.
The minimum for a genuine short programme — physician consultation, five treatment days and a rest day.
Coastal wind-down and a gentle reintroduction to normal life before flying home.

days.label: Arrive Trivandrum
days.body: Transfer to the Kollam-district retreat (~1.5 hrs). Check-in, orientation and a light early dinner — no consultation on arrival day.

days.label: Physician consultation
days.body: An Ayurvedic physician assesses constitution and imbalance and prescribes the programme — treatments, sequence and diet.

days.label: Treatment programme
days.body: Five days on the prescribed regimen: daily oil massage and/or oil-pouring sessions, morning yoga and timed meals, with one rest day placed by the physician.

days.label: Drive to Varkala
days.body: A short, easy ~1-hour transfer. Afternoon free to walk the cliff path.

days.label: Varkala, unstructured
days.body: Cliff-top walks, the Papanasam Beach mineral springs, or simply the beach — nothing booked.

days.label: Depart
days.body: Transfer to Trivandrum airport, about 45 minutes.

stays.name: Kalari Kovilakom (CGH Earth)
stays.why: A restored 18th-century palace run purely as a physician-led Ayurveda retreat — the reference pick.

stays.name: Vivenda dos Palhaços
stays.why: A small, design-led, cliff-adjacent boutique property — an easy step down from a quiet retreat.
